XERIUS develops miniaturised trackers and data loggers using GPS, Argos, VHF, UHF, GSM and RFID technologies.
Each technical solution is customised and engineered to a specific customer or scientific need.
Every system is designed, developed and produced in-house. This production strategy helps to reduce development time and costs.

entityDescription:
Yordas Group is a leading provider of scientific, environmental, human health, global regulatory, sustainability and product stewardship consulting services. Yordas has a solid and internationally recognised reputation as a provider of training, advice and services to ensure compliance across the globe, with regional representation and service providers in Europe, the Americas and Asia Pacific.
Delivering innovative solutions for business, industry and government, Yordas continues to create value and sustainability for our clients. The key sectors we serve include Consumer Goods, Manufacturing, Chemical, Agrochemical, Oil & Gas, and Mining. Crosscutting themes such as Sustainability, Product Stewardship, Chemical Notification Systems, Environmental Permitting, and Waste Management are within the broad portfolio of services we provide to our customers.
Our Strap line, “Business through Science” reflects the essence of our organisation and the drive to underpin our work through exceptional technical and scientific expertise. In-line with the ever increasing need for the business to effectively integrate sustainable considerations along its value chain, we have extended our portfolio with cutting-edge tools and expertise to support our clients to actively manage the social, economic and environmental effects stemming from their operations while meeting regulatory demands. Highlighting the depth of our knowledge, we undertake research in a number of specialised fields such as nanomaterials risk assessment, biocides and pesticides, green chemistry, and systematic review methodologies for hazard assessment.

entityDescription: MITIGA Solutions is a spin-off of the Barcelona Supercomputing Center, a world renowned institution with over two decades of experience in developing and implementing models in the fields of geophysics, volcanology and atmospheric science under one roof. The Center houses MareNostrum, one of the most powerful supercomputers in Europe. We bring this expertise together with computational resources to help make the world safer and more resilient against natural hazards. We bridge the gap between scientific research and operational impact, helping our clients manage their risks and make their decision-making more accurate, reliable and timely. We believe science can make the world safer and more resilient against natural hazards. We harness supercomputers and data science/analytics to build whole-cycle solutions for the aviation industry, insurance, and humanitarian sectors, amongst others. We leverage world-class scientists and tech experts to make decision-making more accurate, reliable and timely.AVIATION:MITIGA FLYaware is a decision-making tool that helps aviation stakeholders reduce the impact of volcanic ash, mineral dust, sea salt and other atmospheric hazards. We combine global high-res weather data; flight plan configuration/routes; and engine dose to aerosol contaminants with ICE, our Impact Calculator Engine tool, to inform safer and more efficient air traffic and asset management. MITIGA FLYaware benefits the following aviation stakeholders:- Airlines: improved flight operations, maintenance, asset utilization, and disruption management- Airports: optimized air and ground traffic management- Lessors: asset utilization and optimization- Engine manufacturers: predictive maintenance and asset optimization INSURANCE:In 2018, insured losses from the California Wildfires alone topped $12B. MITIGA E2E Fire System is our disruptive technology that helps manage wildfire risks. It outperforms traditional cat modeling, with greater competitive advantage to its users: insurance/reinsurance, energy companies and governments. It provides critical information in three phases: (i) prevention (live and historical risk indexes); (ii) reaction (fire spread in real time); and (iii) diagnosis (AI and big data, including a social disaster management component).E2E Fire System offers:- High-res Early Warning System that facilitates preventive measures and reduces the impact of a catastrophic event - contrary to current probabilistic assessments that take a long-term view of the wildfire risk in a specified region, based on static catalogues of events..- High-Performance Computing (HPC) that runs hundreds of thousands of simulations a week (up to 30-meter spatial res) to assess the spread probability of wildfires with respect to projected high-res fuel conditions and weather forecasts. It helps determine investment decisions around forest cleaning and land management. HUMANITARIAN:Traditional aid is rarely sufficient to cover humanitarian needs worldwide. So we transfer our industry tech solutions to benefit the humanitarian sector. Through MITIGA4Good, we use state-of-the-art climate-related scientific technology to help build financial tools (e.g. cat bonds, parametric insurance, etc) that use parametric triggers for payouts. Unlike traditional insurance policies, when pre-determined triggers related to a natural disaster are met (measured by science - not by on-site auditors), funds are disbursed rapidly to build resilience and reduce vulnerability. This way, we help leverage capital markets to provide emergency funding to complement aid gaps. MITIGA4Good suite offers: - Probabilistic models to calculate the expected financial loss to investors in the event of a natural hazard.- Short-term, deterministic impact models to generate post-event risk scenarios to help at-risk communities receive critical humanitarian assistance without delay.

entityDescription:
ChAI forecasts commodity prices using the latest AI methods on both traditional and alternative data (including satellite and maritime). ChAI makes predictions on a daily basis for time horizons of one week to one year into the future, across a range of commodities (predominately metals).

ChAI uses data sources flexibly, meaning that we only select the most relevant data sets for each commodity when making our predictions - one size doesn't fit all. Furthermore, ChAI's algorithms are fully explainable, helping our clients understand the weight given to each input source and providing a full probability distribution for each prediction made, for example, so that asset managers/traders can position size based on how wide these distributions are.

entityName: UNIVERSITA CA FOSCARI VENEZIA - European Centre for Living Technology (ECLT)
entityDescription:
Founded in 2004 the European Centre for Living Technology (ECLT, www.ecltech.org) is an international and interdisciplinary research centre established 

as an inter-university consortium, currently involving 17 European and 

extra-European institutional affiliates. The Centre is devoted to the 

study of technologies that exhibit life-like properties including 

self-organization, adaptability and the capacity to evolve. Several 

Research Units are currently present and include Complexity and Data 

Analysis, Artificial Intelligence, and Bioinspired Design.
ECLT

received its initial funding in 2004 through the PACE project 

(Programmable Artificial Cell Evolution, FP6), and continued to pursue 

cutting-edge research as coordinator and partner in European projects 

(FP6, FP7, H2020 and EuropeAid).
ECLT

has developed extensive experience and competence in project 

coordination and planning, including the involvement of SMEs, and civil 

society organizations.
